prompt: wordcount.py has a bug. count_words(text) must count words case-insensitively, where a word is a run of letters and/or digits and every other character (punctuation, apostrophes, whitespace) merely separates words and is dropped. Symptom: count_words('Hi, hi! hi.') returns {'hi,': 1, 'hi!': 1, 'hi.': 1}, expected {'hi': 3}. By the same rule count_words("it's ok") is {'it': 1, 's': 1, 'ok': 1}. Plain space-separated text already counts correctly. Do not change the signature.
